mapper.insert: INSERT INTO med_appointment_limit (appointment_date, actual_limit, max_limit, actual_count, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{appointmentDate}, #{actualLimit}, #{maxLimit}, 1, #{remark}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actual_count = actual_count + 1
mapper.select: select appointment_date as appointmentDate, actual_limit as actualLimit, max_limit as maxLimit, actual_count as actualCount from med_appointment_limit where appointment_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} order by appointmentDate;

select appointment_date as appointmentDate, actual_limit as actualLimit, max_limit as maxLimit, actual_count as actualCount from med_appointment_limit where appointment_date = #{appointmentDate} limit 1
